name: vllm_cp_gather_cache
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_cp_gather_cache.py. Gather cache from blocks: src_cache (num_blocks, block_size, num_heads, head_size) fp16, dst preallocated (total_tokens, num_heads, head_size), block_table (batch_size, blocks_per_seq) int32, cu_seq_lens int32 cumsum, batch_size scalar. Reference mutates dst via vLLM _custom_ops.cp_gather_cache (seq_starts=None default) and returns dst. Shapes interdependent (total_tokens=batch_size*blocks_per_seq*block_size) → gen_inputs. Test uses blocks_per_seq=2 fixed. Requires vLLM at eval time.
